Sun, Nov 22: 6,100 deer reported statewide (3,492 antlered, 2,608 antlerless). Season total: 203,808.

Montcalm moved from #2 to #1 in the county rankings Sunday, passing Saginaw, with 162 new reports (96 antlered, 66 antlerless). Statewide, new reports slipped to 6,100 from 7,249 on Saturday.
